native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] SolarMarker (aka Jupyter) Backdoor
native_rule.s1ql:
(
  event.type = 'Process Creation'
  OR event.type = 'Command Script'
)
AND
(
  (
    (
      src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'IO.File]::ReadAllText'
      OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'iO.FiLe]::ReadAllBytes'
    )
    AND src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Reflection.Assembly]::Load'
    AND
    (
      (
        src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'Convert]::FromBase64String'
        AND src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'CreateDecryptor'
      )
      OR
      (
        src.process.commandLine contains:anycase '-Lt'
        AND src.process.commandLine contains:anycase '.COUnT'
        AND src.process.commandLine contains:anycase ' -BXOr'
        AND src.process.commandLine contains:anycase ' -GE'
        AND src.process.commandLine contains:anycase '.length'
      )
    )
  )
  OR
  (
    cmdScript.content contains:anycase 'IO.File]::ReadAllText'
    AND cmdScript.content contains:anycase 'Reflection.Assembly]::Load'
    AND
    (
      (
        cmdScript.content contains:anycase 'Convert]::FromBase64String'
        AND cmdScript.content contains:anycase 'CreateDecryptor'
      )
      OR
      (
        cmdScript.content contains:anycase '-Lt'
        AND cmdScript.content contains:anycase '.COUnT'
        AND cmdScript.content contains:anycase ' -BXOr'
        AND cmdScript.content contains:anycase ' -GE'
        AND cmdScript.content contains:anycase '.length'
      )
    )
  )
)
